title: Navigation and overlays
description: Tabs, stepper, breadcrumb, action menu, modal and drawer. All are keyboard-navigable, and that is where their quality is decided: these are the components for which no native element provides the expected behaviour.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.note: Several views of one object, not navigation between pages: if each panel deserves its own address — and it does as soon as you want to send it by email — links are what you need. Arrows move focus, Enter activates: automatic activation would trigger a load on every arrow press.

steps.title: Stepper
steps.note: The submission form has seven steps. The stepper must say where you are, how many remain, and which are in default: a step completed then invalidated by a change request must be visible from any other, otherwise the proposal goes back with the same flaw. State is carried by shape as much as by colour.
steps.label: Submission steps

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.note: It invents nothing: each page declares its own. No breadcrumb is better than one derived from the URL, which would show a technical identifier as a link. Two kinds of label live side by side — a translation key for the interface, already-resolved text for what comes from the database.

overlays.title: Modal, drawer, action menu
overlays.note: The modal interrupts, the drawer accompanies: the latter serves the detail of a row you are browsing, the former a decision to be taken before anything else. Both build on the native element — the browser's top layer, focus trapping and Escape-to-close, without a line of keyboard code.
overlays.modalDescription: The organization will be notified of the decision and its reason.
overlays.modalBody: The proposal will move to the “rejected” state. The decision is recorded with its author and reason, and remains visible in the proposal history.
overlays.modalWarning: A reason is required: the database refuses the transition without one.
overlays.drawerDescription: The detail without leaving the list.

bars.title: Navigation bars
bars.note: The two bars are not rendered in a demonstration frame: they are in front of you. Duplicating them here would stack two headers and put two navigation landmarks in the document.
bars.navbar: The main bar is at the top of this page: entries, language switch, theme toggle, menu collapsed below 1024 px.
bars.sidenav: The side navigation is the back office's. It carries the administration scope selector, which filters every list in that section.
